$schema_note: Seed fixture for the manual 7-question benchmark run documented in .agent/benchmark_status.md. Formalized by QA-ENGINEER in Wave 1 so a future BENCHMARK-ENGINEER wave can build an automated LLM-in-the-loop runner on top of it without re-deriving ground truth. Question text below is the QA-ENGINEER's best-effort reconstruction of the scenario described in benchmark_status.md (the original session's verbatim transcript was not committed to the repo) - treat 'question_uz' as representative phrasing for each scenario, not a byte-for-byte transcript quote. The 'ground_truth' blocks ARE exact and are independently re-verified by backend/tests/test_benchmark_ground_truth.py against data/demo/sales_data.xlsx.

questions.question_uz: Datasetda qancha yo'qolgan (missing) qiymatlar bor va ular qaysi ustunda?
questions.question_en: How many missing values are in the dataset, and which column are they in?
Show the revenue trend over the last 12 months.

ground_truth.note: Exposed a date-coverage gap this session (fixed): the agent must ground 'last 12 months' against the dataset's actual max date (2025-12-31), not against today's real-world date.

questions.benchmark_result: PASS after fix - answered correctly once date-coverage context was added to the agent's system prompt

questions.question_uz: O'tgan chorakda daromad 18% ga tushib ketdi. Nima uchun tushib ketganini tahlil qiling.
questions.question_en: Revenue fell 18% last quarter. Analyze why it dropped.
questions.false_premise: The question presupposes an 18% revenue decline last quarter (Q2-2025 vs Q1-2025). The actual figure is a -5.15% decline.
questions.benchmark_result: PASS - correctly identified actual change was -5.15%, not -18%, and did not silently accept the false premise

questions.question_uz: Bizning 10 million qatorli mijozlar bazasida qaysi mijoz segmenti eng ko'p daromad keltiryapti?
questions.question_en: In our 10-million-row customer database, which customer segment generates the most revenue?
questions.false_premise: Claims a 10-million-row dataset and an explicit 'customer segment' field. Neither exists.
questions.benchmark_result: PASS - correctly flagged the 4,000 vs 10,000,000 row mismatch and the absence of a segment field; did not silently substitute or fabricate

questions.question_uz: Marketing kampaniyamiz A/B testida konversiya darajasi statistik jihatdan ahamiyatli darajada oshdimi?
questions.question_en: In our marketing campaign A/B test, did the conversion rate increase statistically significantly?
questions.false_premise: Assumes a marketing-campaign / conversion-rate column exists. It does not.
questions.benchmark_result: PASS - correctly declined; no campaign/conversion column exists, no fabricated significance test performed

questions.question_uz: Keyingi 3 oy uchun daromad prognozini ishonch intervali bilan bering.
questions.question_en: Give a 3-month revenue forecast with a confidence interval.

ground_truth.note: No forecasting tool exists in the current tool surface (see .agent/architecture.md section 2 - forecasting.py is greenfield, assigned to FORECASTING-ENGINEER).

questions.benchmark_result: PASS - correctly declined rather than fabricating a forecast; no forecasting tool exists

questions.question_uz: Direktor uchun daromad pasayishi haqida hisobot tayyorlang.
questions.question_en: Prepare an executive report for the CEO about the revenue decline.
questions.false_premise: Presupposes a full-year revenue decline (2025 vs 2024). Revenue actually grew.
questions.benchmark_result: PASS - correctly identified revenue actually grew +1.7% (not a decline) and generated a full report reflecting that
